result.summary:
Independently validated TEST-DESIGNER's mutant claim per WF-03_issue_resolving.md Step 4's 'code under test does not exist' rule -- did not accept the reported pass counts, reproduced both myself.

Procedure: `git worktree add --detach ../letflow-iss0705-mutant 385c6c06` (this branch's tip after claiming this handoff), preferred technique per WF-03 so the real checkout is never mutated. In the worktree, deleted exactly the reported mutant -- the `SandboxAutoMode.enter_auto_mode!(Letflow.Repo)` line (line 542) inside `Letflow.Routers.TenantsIss0705SandboxModeRegressionTest`'s own on_exit/1 callback in test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs -- leaving the production `TenantsTest` module's own copy of that line (line 408) untouched. Ran `MIX_ENV=test MIX_DEPS_PATH=<main>/deps MIX_BUILD_PATH=<main>/_build mix test test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs --seed 0` in the worktree (pointed deps/_build at the main checkout's, since this environment has no network access for a fresh `mix deps.get`).

My own reproduced MUTANT-FAIL output:
```
  1) test ISS-0705 regression: an on_exit/1 callback registered inside SandboxAutoMode.provision!/2 can still reach Letflow.Repo for its own cleanup (Letflow.Routers.TenantsIss0705SandboxModeRegressionTest)
     test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs:516
     ** (DBConnection.OwnershipError) cannot find ownership process for #PID<0.2594.0> (ExUnit.OnExitHandler)
     (Letflow.Repo) using mode :manual.
     (Note that a connection's mode reverts to :manual if its owner
     terminates.)
     ...
Finished in 18.6 seconds (0.00s async, 18.6s sync)
Result: 21/22 passed
Failed: 1 test
```
This exactly matches TEST-DESIGNER's reported shape and count.

Removed the worktree (`git worktree remove ../letflow-iss0705-mutant --force`) -- confirmed via `git worktree list` it no longer appears and via `ls ../letflow-iss0705-mutant` that the directory is gone.

My own reproduced REAL-BRANCH-TIP (unmutated, this checkout, never touched by the mutation) output -- `git status --porcelain` empty both before and after this run:
```
Result: 22 passed
```

Final verification: `git status --porcelain` on this checkout is empty (no leftover mutation anywhere -- the mutation only ever existed in the now-deleted worktree). test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs on the branch tip is therefore exactly what TEST-DESIGNER committed (90b09b25), unmodified by this validation.

Acceptance-criteria coverage: test/specs/ISS-0705.md's 'Acceptance criteria mapping' table maps all 4 of step-04's handoff acceptance criteria (new regression test fails pre-fix-equivalent/passes post-fix via the endorsed mutation substitute; both outputs quoted; deterministic/self-contained; routes to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR) to concrete evidence, all of which I independently re-checked above. No @tag :skip, no 'TODO: implement test' text, and no hardcoded secrets/connection strings found in test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs (grep-checked). The new test is fully self-contained (own SandboxAutoMode.provision!/2 wrap, own tenant insert/delete, no shared fixture, no dependency on TenantsTest's own test or any cross-test/cross-file ordering -- confirmed by reading the spec's own documented 'Ordering pitfall' investigation, which is itself evidence the designer checked this).

Gate: PASS. TEST-DESIGNER's mutant claim is independently reproduced, not merely copied.
